question: What claim is made about the effect of poison in the body of one who has been bitten by great serpents?
premises: A person is described as bitten by great serpents.
Poison is the agent in question.
It is claimed that poison does not enter the body in that case.
inference: For one bitten by great serpents, poison does not enter the body.
uncertainties: The reason for this immunity is not stated in this verse.
plain_english: Poison does not enter the body, even if one has been bitten by great serpents.
